description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor, which provides an abstract base class for data preprocessing in the Image_Graph package. It includes methods for constructing instances and processing values, intended to be extended for specific preprocessing tasks.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor
classes.description: An abstract base class for data preprocessors used in the Image_Graph package. It provides a constructor and a default _process method that returns the value unaltered. Subclasses are expected to override _process for custom behavior.

methods.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor
methods.description: Constructor method for the class. Currently does nothing but can be extended.

methods.name: _process
methods.description: Processes the input value for formatting or transformation. The default implementation returns the value unchanged.
